# AI tools that run your online retail, on every channel

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> AI listing optimisation, auto shipping, graphics, reconciliation, social media and order management for retailers on Amazon, eBay, Kogan and Bunnings.

eComChannels is a multichannel commerce platform for online retailers: AI listing optimisation, auto shipping, product graphics, finance reconciliation and social media outreach, built on one order management system for every marketplace and store.

Free for 30 days. Our team sets you up and walks you through the platform.

## Why retailers run every channel from one platform

- One product record. AI adapts it to every marketplace, so a correction is made once.

- One stock figure. Inventory is held centrally per SKU and pushed to each channel, which reduces overselling.

- One shipping workflow. Every courier, label and tracking update from one screen.

- One set of numbers. Payouts are matched to orders, so finance and operations agree.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is eComChannels?
eComChannels is a multichannel commerce platform for online retailers. Its products cover AI listing optimisation, AI auto shipping, AI graphics, finance auto reconciliation, AI social media outreach, order management and branded storefronts, all working from the same product and order data.

### Which sales channels does eComChannels work with?
Amazon, TikTok Shop, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan, plus Shopify, WooCommerce and eComChannels storefronts. It also connects to every marketplace built on Mirakl, including Bunnings, Kmart, JB Hi-Fi, Myer, Country Road Group, Velocity, Decathlon, Baby Bunting, Freedom, Spotlight, Paramount Liquor, CampbellsPlus and Onceit, plus Mirakl marketplaces overseas. MyDeal closed in September 2025 and its sellers now trade on BIG W Market and Everyday Market.

### Which is the biggest online marketplace in Australia?
By the annual revenue of the company behind it, Amazon is the largest, followed by TikTok Shop (ByteDance), Temu (PDD Holdings), Woolworths Group (Everyday Market and BIG W Market) and Wesfarmers (Bunnings and Kmart marketplaces). The full ranking with sources is at https://ecomchannels.com/channels/.

### Do you support Mirakl marketplaces?
Yes. eComChannels connects to any marketplace built on Mirakl through the Mirakl seller API, using the shop API key the marketplace gives you. That covers 13 Mirakl marketplaces in Australia and New Zealand and more than 280 overseas. The full list is at https://ecomchannels.com/channels/#mirakl.
[More questions and answers](https://ecomchannels.com/faq/)

# AI listing optimisation for every marketplace

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/ai-listing-optimisation/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Listing AI already trained on each marketplace’s rules writes titles, bullets and descriptions for Amazon, Woolworths, BIG W, Bunnings, Kmart and more.

Write a product once. The eComChannels listing AI is already trained on the listing rules of every marketplace we support, so it adapts titles, bullet points, descriptions and attributes to each channel straight away. Your team reviews and approves the copy before it is published.

→

## Features

### Already trained on every marketplace’s rules
Title lengths, bullet counts, banned words, required attributes and category rules are already trained into the AI for each marketplace, so there is no set-up before your first listing.

### AI drafts, people approve
AI produces the first draft from your product data. Nothing goes live until a reviewer approves it, and every approved version is kept.

### One product record
A single master product feeds every channel, so a correction is made once and flows to every listing.

### Keyword and content research
AI-assisted product research suggests the terms shoppers use, to help listings be found in marketplace search.

### Bulk updates
Optimise a whole range at once instead of editing listings one marketplace at a time.

### Consistent brand voice
Copy follows your own style guide across Amazon, eBay, Kogan, Bunnings and your web store.

## Before and after

Before: supplier dataWater Bottle BlueSteel bottle. 750ml.

- No brand, features or size in the title
- No bullet points or search terms
- Missing required marketplace attributes

After: written to each marketplace's rules
AmazonYourBrand 750 ml Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, Leak-Proof Lid, Keeps Drinks Cold 24 Hours, BPA-Free, Blue
- Double-wall vacuum keeps drinks cold 24 h, hot 12 h
- Leak-proof screw lid for bags
- 18/8 stainless steel, BPA-free115 characters, written to Amazon rules

KoganYourBrand 750ml Insulated Steel Water Bottle (Blue)
- 24 h cold / 12 h hot
- Leak-proof lid
- BPA-free51 characters, written to Kogan rules

BunningsYourBrand 750ml Blue Insulated Water Bottle
- Capacity: 750 ml
- Material: 18/8 stainless steel
- Height: 27 cm43 characters, written to Bunnings rules

## Questions about AI listing optimisation

### Which marketplaces is the listing AI trained for?
It is already trained on the listing rules of Amazon, TikTok Shop, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan, plus Shopify, WooCommerce and eComChannels storefronts.

### Does AI publish listings automatically?
No. The AI drafts to each marketplace’s trained rules, and a person on your team approves them before they are published.

# AI auto shipping for Australian retailers

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/ai-shipping/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Book Australia Post, StarTrack, CouriersPlease and Allied Express from one screen: labels, manifests and tracking sent to every channel automatically.

Ship every order from one screen. eComChannels books the courier, prints the label, manifests the shipment and sends tracking back to the customer and the marketplace automatically.

[Image: Australia Post] [Image: StarTrack] [Image: CouriersPlease] [Image: Allied Express] 

## Features

### All your courier accounts in one place
Connect Australia Post, StarTrack, CouriersPlease and Allied Express accounts and ship with each from the same workflow.

### Automatic labels
Labels are created from the order’s address, weight and dimensions, ready to print in batches.

### Manifests
Close out the day’s shipments per courier with a manifest, without re-keying consignments.

### Tracking sent back automatically
As soon as a shipment is labelled, tracking numbers go back to the customer and to the marketplace the order came from.

### Shipment status board
See every parcel move from labelled to manifested to tracking sent, so nothing is missed at cut-off.

### Courier claims
Lodge and follow up lost or damaged parcel claims next to the shipment they belong to.

## From order to tracking, automatically
🧾Order in→🏷️Label printed→📋Manifested→📍Tracking sent
[Image: Australia Post logo] Australia Post [Image: StarTrack logo] StarTrack [Image: CouriersPlease logo] CouriersPlease [Image: Allied Express logo] Allied Express
## Supported couriers
[Image: Australia Post logo] 
### Australia Post
Labels, manifests and tracking for Australia Post parcels.
[Image: StarTrack logo] 
### StarTrack
StarTrack consignments booked from the same shipping screen.
[Image: CouriersPlease logo] 
### CouriersPlease
CouriersPlease bookings, labels, tracking and claims.
[Image: Allied Express logo] 
### Allied Express
Allied Express jobs for bulky and heavy freight.

## Questions about AI auto shipping

### Which couriers does eComChannels shipping support?
Australia Post, StarTrack, CouriersPlease and Allied Express.

### Is tracking sent to marketplaces automatically?
Yes. Once a shipment is labelled, its tracking number is sent back to the customer and to the marketplace or store the order came from.

# AI graphics for e-commerce and online retailers

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/ai-graphics/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Graphics AI already trained on each marketplace’s image rules creates product images and infographics, with one approval for every channel.

Every marketplace wants different product images. The eComChannels graphics AI is already trained on each marketplace’s image rules (image count, sizes, backgrounds and infographic slots), produces the graphics to match, and publishes approved images to every channel that uses the set.

## Features

### Already trained on every marketplace’s image rules
Image count, sizes, white-background and infographic slot rules for each marketplace are already trained into the AI and kept as image sets, so every graphic is made to spec.

### AI-assisted creation
AI helps generate and edit product graphics, lifestyle scenes and infographics from your product data and photos.

### Approve once, publish everywhere
Approving a product’s images for a set publishes them to every channel on that set.

### Designer workflow
Queues for designers and approvers show what is missing, what is waiting for review and what is ready.

### Organised by SKU
Images, documents and videos are stored per SKU, in slot order, ready for listings and your web store.

### Readiness at a glance
See which products are ready for which channels before you list them.

## Questions about AI graphics

### How does eComChannels handle different marketplace image rules?
Each marketplace is mapped to an image set that holds its slot rules. Designers produce images to the set, and approval publishes them to every channel that uses it.

### Can AI create product images?
Yes. The graphics AI, already trained on each marketplace’s image rules, generates and edits product graphics, and every image is reviewed before it is approved for a channel.

# Finance auto reconciliation for marketplaces and online retailers

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/finance-reconciliation/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Reconcile marketplace remittances and settlements against orders automatically, with fee rules and reports. Amazon, eBay, Kogan, Bunnings and more.

Marketplaces pay in batches, net of commissions and fees. eComChannels imports each remittance, matches every line to its order, applies your fee and settlement rules and shows what is paid, short-paid or missing.

matched · short-paid · unmatched

## Features

### Remittance import
Upload or import remittance and settlement files from each marketplace, with a saved import layout per channel.

### Automatic order matching
Each payout line is matched to its sales order and invoice, so only the exceptions need a person.

### Fee and settlement rules
Commission, fee and settlement rules per channel explain the difference between the sale and the payout.

### Exceptions first
Short payments, unmatched lines and unpaid orders are flagged for follow-up.

### Finance dashboard and reports
See receipts, fees and outstanding amounts by channel and period.

### Invoices from orders
Invoices are generated from sales orders, so finance works from the same data as operations.

## How payouts are matched

| Order | Channel | Payout status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Order #1042 | Amazon | Matched |
| Order #1043 | BIG W Market | Matched |
| Order #1044 | Bunnings | Short-paid |
| Order #1045 | Kogan | Matched |
| Order #1046 | eBay | Not in payout |
Illustration: each payout line is matched to its order, and only exceptions need a person.

## Questions about Finance auto reconciliation

### What does marketplace reconciliation mean?
Checking that every order sold on a marketplace was paid for, at the right amount after commission and fees, by matching remittance or settlement lines to orders.

### Which channels can be reconciled?
Any marketplace or store whose remittance or settlement report can be imported, including Amazon, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan and Shopify.

> AI plans, writes and schedules posts for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, X, Threads and RedNote, with human approval.

Keep every social channel active without writing every post by hand. eComChannels uses AI to plan content from your live products and campaigns, writes copy for each platform, and publishes once your team approves.

Every post is a versioned draft that a person approves before it is published.

### Product images ready to use

# Multichannel order management system (OMS)

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/order-management/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> The eComChannels OMS brings orders, inventory, purchasing, pricing, B2B and customer service for every marketplace and web store into one system.

The core of eComChannels: a cloud order management system that brings every order, every stock movement and every product into one place. It runs in the browser; there is nothing to install.

[Image: Amazon Australia] [Image: TikTok Shop] [Image: Temu (Local Seller)] [Image: Woolworths Everyday Market] [Image: BIG W Market] [Image: MyDeal] [Image: Bunnings Marketplace] [Image: Kmart Marketplace] 

## Features

### One order queue
Orders from every marketplace and store arrive in one queue to be allocated, picked, packed and shipped.

### Inventory and warehouses
One stock position per SKU across warehouses, pushed to every channel to prevent overselling.

### Pricing
Price books and pricing rules per channel and country, including tax handling.

### Purchasing
Purchase orders, goods receiving and supplier information next to the products they belong to.

### B2B and wholesale
Serve trade customers from the same catalogue and stock as your retail channels.

### Customer service
A shared team inbox with the order in view, so support can answer without switching systems.

## Connected channels

- [Image: Amazon Australia logo] Amazon Australia
- [Image: Temu (Local Seller) logo] Temu (Local Seller)
- [Image: Woolworths Everyday Market logo] Woolworths Everyday Market
- [Image: BIG W Market logo] BIG W Market

- [Image: Kogan Marketplace logo] Kogan Marketplace
- [Image: Shopify logo] Shopify[See all channels, couriers and platforms](https://ecomchannels.com/channels/)

## Questions about Order management (OMS)

### What does an order management system (OMS) do?
An OMS collects orders from every place you sell, keeps one accurate stock figure per product and runs fulfilment, with tracking sent back to each sales channel.

### Does eComChannels prevent overselling?
Stock is held centrally per SKU and the available quantity is pushed to each connected channel, so a sale on one marketplace reduces what is offered on the others.

# Branded storefronts, connected to your OMS

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/products/storefronts/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Your own branded online store on the eComChannels storefront engine: SEO and AI-search friendly, with products, prices and stock from the OMS.

The eComChannels storefront engine powers branded web stores. Each store has its own theme and content, while products, prices and stock come directly from the order management system.

## Features

### Search and AI friendly
Server-rendered pages, clean URLs, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, schema.org structured data and llms.txt for AI assistants.

### Fed by the OMS
Products, prices and stock are pushed from the OMS, and web orders flow into the same order queue as your marketplaces.

### Your brand, your theme
Each store has its own Liquid theme and content.

### Checkout and payments
Cart and checkout with online payment providers built in.

## Questions about Branded storefronts

### Can I run my own online store with eComChannels?
Yes. The storefront engine powers branded web stores with server-rendered, search-friendly pages, and products, prices and stock come straight from the OMS.

# Frequently asked questions

URL: https://ecomchannels.com/faq/
Updated: 2026-10-30

> Answers about eComChannels products: AI listings, shipping couriers, AI graphics, marketplace reconciliation, social media, OMS and storefronts.

Short answers about eComChannels and its products.

### What is eComChannels?
eComChannels is a multichannel commerce platform for online retailers. Its products cover AI listing optimisation, AI auto shipping, AI graphics, finance auto reconciliation, AI social media outreach, order management and branded storefronts, all working from the same product and order data.

### Which sales channels does eComChannels work with?
Amazon, TikTok Shop, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan, plus Shopify, WooCommerce and eComChannels storefronts. It also connects to every marketplace built on Mirakl, including Bunnings, Kmart, JB Hi-Fi, Myer, Country Road Group, Velocity, Decathlon, Baby Bunting, Freedom, Spotlight, Paramount Liquor, CampbellsPlus and Onceit, plus Mirakl marketplaces overseas. MyDeal closed in September 2025 and its sellers now trade on BIG W Market and Everyday Market.

### Which is the biggest online marketplace in Australia?
By the annual revenue of the company behind it, Amazon is the largest, followed by TikTok Shop (ByteDance), Temu (PDD Holdings), Woolworths Group (Everyday Market and BIG W Market) and Wesfarmers (Bunnings and Kmart marketplaces). The full ranking with sources is at https://ecomchannels.com/channels/.

### Do you support Mirakl marketplaces?
Yes. eComChannels connects to any marketplace built on Mirakl through the Mirakl seller API, using the shop API key the marketplace gives you. That covers 13 Mirakl marketplaces in Australia and New Zealand and more than 280 overseas. The full list is at https://ecomchannels.com/channels/#mirakl.

### Which couriers are supported?
Australia Post, StarTrack, CouriersPlease and Allied Express.

### Is there a free trial?
Yes. eComChannels products are currently available on a 30-day free trial. Book a demo or request a trial and our team will set you up and show you around.

### How do I book a demo?
Use the Book a demo page to tell us about your business and choose a preferred time. Our team will confirm the time and walk you through the products live.

### Can I use only one product?
Talk to us about the products you need. Each product works from the same central product and order data.

### How do I get started?
Book a demo or request your 30-day free trial at https://ecomchannels.com/book-a-demo/, or email support@ecomchannels.com.

### Which marketplaces is the listing AI trained for?
It is already trained on the listing rules of Amazon, TikTok Shop, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan, plus Shopify, WooCommerce and eComChannels storefronts.

### Does AI publish listings automatically?
No. The AI drafts to each marketplace’s trained rules, and a person on your team approves them before they are published.

### Which couriers does eComChannels shipping support?
Australia Post, StarTrack, CouriersPlease and Allied Express.

### Is tracking sent to marketplaces automatically?
Yes. Once a shipment is labelled, its tracking number is sent back to the customer and to the marketplace or store the order came from.

### How does eComChannels handle different marketplace image rules?
Each marketplace is mapped to an image set that holds its slot rules. Designers produce images to the set, and approval publishes them to every channel that uses it.

### Can AI create product images?
Yes. The graphics AI, already trained on each marketplace’s image rules, generates and edits product graphics, and every image is reviewed before it is approved for a channel.

### What does marketplace reconciliation mean?
Checking that every order sold on a marketplace was paid for, at the right amount after commission and fees, by matching remittance or settlement lines to orders.

### Which channels can be reconciled?
Any marketplace or store whose remittance or settlement report can be imported, including Amazon, Temu, Woolworths Everyday Market, BIG W Market, Bunnings Marketplace, Kmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, Myer Marketplace, THE ICONIC, Lasoo, Temple & Webster, Baby Bunting and Kogan and Shopify.

### Which social media platforms does eComChannels support?
Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, X, Threads and RedNote (Xiaohongshu).

### Does AI post without approval?
No. AI drafts and schedules posts, and each one is approved by a person before it is published.

### What does an order management system (OMS) do?
An OMS collects orders from every place you sell, keeps one accurate stock figure per product and runs fulfilment, with tracking sent back to each sales channel.

### Does eComChannels prevent overselling?
Stock is held centrally per SKU and the available quantity is pushed to each connected channel, so a sale on one marketplace reduces what is offered on the others.

### Can I run my own online store with eComChannels?
Yes. The storefront engine powers branded web stores with server-rendered, search-friendly pages, and products, prices and stock come straight from the OMS.
